purpose: Stress-test one-to-many provision lineage using an official correlation table.
assertions: A lineage model must allow one predecessor provision instance to have multiple successor provision instances.
A single stable provision ID cannot represent this transition without losing branching structure.
The correlation table proves structural lineage but does not by itself prove that every legal proposition in the predecessor survives unchanged in both successors.
Conceptual/legal-rule lineage must therefore be separately asserted from structural lineage.
